## What it is

Number 3, rendered green. Front-right, 315°. Recessed 3. Three hooks. The earlier design gave this tower a fourth hook and called it the cut end. That hook is past the tube once the straight entry is taken out of the helix.

## Design notes

- Print it on its side, flat face down. The C is the layer outline.
- The foot is the same 6.0 × 3.2 mm tab. The 3 is recessed into the top face of the rib.
- The neck is 6 mm, with a 3 mm fillet each side where it leaves the rib.

